overview_description.description:
Shift Health is a healthcare strategy consultancy for Healthcare & Life Sciences Leaders. They also work with government, academia, industry, the not-for-profit sector, and healthcare providers to amplify healthcare and research leadership, advance global health innovation and achieve eminence in healthcare markets worldwide.

Shift Health was founded in 1999 and is based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

product.name: Healthcare Strategy Consulting
product.description: Consulting services that provide strategic insights and guidance to leaders in healthcare and life sciences sectors to support health research and innovation.

product.name: Product Development Boot Camp
product.description: A two-day educational program designed to teach strategies and best practices for product development in the life sciences sector.

product.name: Strategic Research and Innovation Reports
product.description: Analytical reports that examine trends, challenges, and opportunities in health research and innovation to inform policy and strategic planning.

product.name: Stakeholder Engagement and Alignment Services
product.description: Services that facilitate consensus-building and strategic alignment among diverse stakeholders in health research and innovation initiatives.
